vulnerable_statements.reason: hive comes from amdgpu_get_xgmi_hive(), which can return NULL (e.g. allocation or kobject init failure, or the hive not set up yet). The XGMI branch only checks !amdgpu_sriov_vf(adev) and num_physical_nodes > 1, never that hive is non-NULL, so &hive->device_list dereferences a NULL pointer and crashes the kernel during GPU recovery.

suggested_fix: Add a NULL check for hive before using it in the XGMI branch, e.g. `if (!amdgpu_sriov_vf(adev) && adev->gmc.xgmi.num_physical_nodes > 1 && hive)`. Another option is to bail out with an error (going to end_reset) when a multi-node XGMI device has no hive, so recovery doesn't fall back to resetting only one device.
